# Anubhav Pandey — Product Designer

## Who is Anubhav Pandey?
Anubhav Pandey is a Product Designer based in India, specialising in enterprise B2B SaaS, sustainability compliance, and AI-driven products. He is the founding designer at Carboledger, where he has owned UX decisions end-to-end across an 11-module platform used by large enterprises in the chemical supply chain. He uses design as a thinking tool — entering ambiguous, expert-driven domains and imposing structure that engineers can build and users can actually operate.

## Current Role
- Company: Carboledger
- Title: Product Designer (Founding)
- Domain: Sustainability compliance, carbon data management, ESG reporting, enterprise B2B SaaS
- Duration: July 2023 to present

## Key Work
- Designed supplier response workflows that reduced enterprise request turnaround by over 95% (from 6 weeks to 8 hours)
- Built a contribution analysis and decision-support tool that cut expert analysis time from half a day to under 1 hour
- Designed role-based access, audit logs, and alias systems encoding regulatory requirements directly into the product experience
- Managed UX coherence across 11 interconnected platform modules
- Supported 7-8 enterprise POCs with approximately 50% conversion rate
